newsitem.title: POLAND: Stalexport shares jump on motorway deal.
newsitem.headline: Stalexport shares jump on motorway deal.

text.p: Polish steel trader Stalexport SA jumped 6.1 percent in heavy trade to 35 zlotys after receiving on Wednesday the concession to modernise and operate a 60 km section of toll highway in southern Poland, traders said.

"Certainly the motorway contract buoyed the stock today," one trader said. The government will cover the costs of modernising the road, which would become Poland's first toll highway by the end of the year.
Passenger cars would pay between 3.0 and 3.5 US cents per kilometre while trucks would pay at least twice that amount.
